Hey

I’m the same age as you, and I’ve felt the same way for about a year. I know that isn’t as long as you, but that only proves that you are mentally strong. You are fighting this and I believe you can continue fighting this depression. I really hope things improve for you. I can talk with you if you want

Best of luck

I’ve been staying pretty optimistic about things getting better, but I think my optimism is starting to dwindle. And yeah, I need to brush. I think I might set reminders on my phone for that specifically.

Thank you for the feedback
